{{Quote|The Treasure of Rafa&mdash;or of the Sharu, as we are now compelled to call it, not for the Rafa System, my dear, but for the ancient race who once flourished there and subsequently vanished without a trace&mdash;is a subject of some interest.|''Ottdefa'' Osuno Whett, to Chief Supervisor Vett Fori|<ref name="LCMS">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>}}
